corpusOverrides.note: All four started from the Japanese file. 蜩 → MM and 搶 → MM came out clean, because Ja reorders the inner bars of 周 and slants the opening dot of 倉. 鬻 → MM dropped three flagged strokes to two and 隼 → Hans three to one; the strokes left over were resolved by an authored path. 倩 was considered for a Ja → Hans override on the flagged-stroke count, two against one, but the simplified and MM files write 青 where the dictionary and Ja write 靑. Form comes before the count, so the starting corpus was kept and the two flags were reordered instead.

directionProbe.threshold: angle over 60° between dictionary and candidate start-to-end vectors
directionProbe.note: 蜩 and 搶 disappeared when the corpus changed, and 鬻 and 隼 shrank. 鱒, 鬒, 瑱, 瑳, 簀, 慼 and 倩 were resolved by reordering and 竈, 窗, 隼 and 鬻 by an authored path. The endpoint assignment check added 鬯, whose interior dots run in the same directions and differ only in order, with a gain of 139.5. Recomputed against the published order and paths, no stroke is over 60°.
directionProbe.form.beats.count: 倩 kept its starting corpus although another corpus carried fewer flagged strokes, because that corpus writes a different form. This is the first time the corpus rule and the form rule pulled in opposite directions; the form rule wins, as in the holds for 靚, 睛, 猜 and 鯖.

subThresholdSlants.method: direction-probe rows recomputed against the published order and paths: 6 rows between 45° and 60°, none corrected
subThresholdSlants.note: Short opening dots and marks the dictionary draws vertically or steeper than the licensed corpora (幬 9 at 51°, 躕 8 at 55°, 崒 4 at 53°, 蹌 10 at 49°, 瘵 1 at 55°, 蹢 8 at 59°). Kept as licensed geometry, as in the earlier batches.

sourceTransform.note: Two dictionary groups carry a horizontal offset, translate(12, -830), as in each batch since 厲 in batch 4. serve.py, source-checks.mjs and direction-probe.mjs accept translate(x, -y), and the published paths come from the licensed corpus, so the offset only affects what the review sheet draws.
